title: Agrestical
summary: AGRES'TICAL, a. [L. agrestis; ager, a field, or the same root.] Rural; rustic; pertaining to fields or the country, in opposition to the city; unpolished.

inlines.v: AGRES'TICAL, a. [L. agrestis; ager, a field, or the same root.] Rural; rustic; pertaining to fields or the country, in opposition to the city; unpolished.
